overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus 2-Person Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a rejuvenating wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for indoor use, this sauna is perfect for basements, master baths, or fitness rooms, providing a sanctuary for muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Crafted from natural Canadian Hemlock wood, it features six PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels strategically placed for optimal heat distribution. With its chromotherapy lighting and Bluetooth-enabled sound system, the Maxxus sauna transforms your space into a personalized spa experience.
